products.name: Blender AI Add-ons
products.note: 3D creation AI plugins; open-source; local processing; model provenance varies by plugin

profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit open-source foundation based around Blender, which it describes as free and open source 3D creation software. The software covers a wide range of production tasks including rendering, rigging, animation, camera and object tracking, visual effects, and 2D drawing directly within a 3D viewport. The site notes that VFX professionals have called Blender's tracker "probably the best tracker in the market," and that the software is used in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films. Blender has a Python-controlled interface and supports community-developed add-ons through a publicly accessible Python API. The foundation is a member of ASWF, Khronos, Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the site lists AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm among its hardware supporters.

On the AI side, the site tracks a product category called Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins for 3D creation that run with local processing and are open source, though model provenance varies by plugin. An upcoming release, Blender 5.2 LTS, is noted as bringing improved memory efficiency for rendering scenes with many image textures through a feature called Cycles Texture Cache. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for the foundation.
